rows.claim: If the mobile code calls truncate without the flag, its previews will get shorter.
rows.evidence: The old truncate hard-cut to exactly `limit` chars (text[:limit-3]+"..."), as shown in the original source and test_hard_cut_legacy. The new default cuts at the last whole word, and the test run's expected output "The quick..." (12 chars) versus the old "The quick br..." (15 chars) shows previews get shorter. The claim is conditional, so the unknown mobile callers don't undermine it.
